description: In every perfection r, a maximal bearer m is at the greatest represented degree: for any bearer x, some bearer z bounds x and m; z is not strictly above m (it would then be more r than m, against maximality), so by excluded middle z is at most m and x is at most m. The greatest-degree genus principle at every perfection then makes m the cause of r in all other bearers. Answers ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107 for this target: the per-respect wrappers it named are now explicit OPEN premises (bare premises are allowed, owner direction 2026-11-07).
